in_sanskrit.name: Dinesh

in_marathi.name: Dineshbhai
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dineshbhai हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Dineshbhai is derived from Sanskrit words ‘Dine’ meaning God and ‘Shay’ meaning wealth. It represents the one who is blessed with God's wealth, both material and spiritual.

in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ God's wealth
